About Speed Bun
Birmingham's Premier Used Car Specialist

At Speed Bun, we believe buying a used car should feel as exciting as driving one. Based in the heart of Birmingham, we hand-pick every vehicle in our showroom — only the finest, fully inspected, and ready to drive away. Whether you're after a sleek saloon, a sporty hatch, or a refined executive cruiser, our team is here to find the perfect match. No pressure. No nonsense. Just great cars at honest prices. We pride ourselves on transparency, quality, and a buying experience that puts you first every single time.
